"False Prophets" is a single by American rapper J.
Cole, released on December 5, 2016 along with his single "Everybody Dies".
The two songs were previewed in the documentary Eyez.

Cole has released seven studio albums, one live album, four compilation albums, four extended plays, four mixtapes, 76 singles (including 37 as a featured artist), two promotional singles, and 33 music videos.
Cole first started rapping in his teens, collaborating with the local Fayetteville hip hop duo Bomm Sheltuh.
The Come Up, his debut mixtape, was released on May 4, 2007.
